name: MVSEP Benchmarks
description: Two new benchmarks for sound source separation tasks, focusing on music demixing to separate tracks such as drums, bass, and vocals from a single audio signal. The benchmarks enable evaluation and comparison of popular sound demixing models and ensembles, supported by an online leaderboard.
typical_sota_score: varies by source; roughly 5–12 dB SDR depending on source (drums/bass/vocals) and track — exact numbers depend on dataset split and metric variant (SDR/SI-SDR).
reputation: MVSEP is a well-known benchmark in music source separation with an active online leaderboard and community use.
notes: Includes leaderboard and datasets available for download; evaluated in Music Demixing Challenge 2023.
